tests.label: COUNT(*)
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM BIG_USERS;

tests.label: WHERE with AND range
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS C FROM BIG_USERS WHERE ID >= 5000 AND ID <= 15000;

tests.label: WHERE with OR chain
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS C FROM BIG_USERS WHERE ID = 1 OR ID = 2 OR ID = 3;

tests.label: Projection query
tests.query: SELECT ID, NAME FROM BIG_USERS WHERE ID <= 3;

tests.label: Float literal predicate
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS C FROM BIG_USERS WHERE BALANCE >= 1000.0;

tests.label: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS
tests.query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS CLAUSE_TMP;

tests.label: CREATE TABLE
tests.query: CREATE TABLE CLAUSE_TMP(ID DECIMAL, V DECIMAL);

tests.label: INSERT multi-row
tests.query: INSERT INTO CLAUSE_TMP VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20), (3, 30);

tests.label: JOIN
tests.query: SELECT C.ID, C.V, B.NAME FROM CLAUSE_TMP C INNER JOIN BIG_USERS B ON B.ID = C.ID;

tests.label: Duplicate key reject
tests.query: INSERT INTO CLAUSE_TMP VALUES (1, 999);

tests.label: DROP TABLE cleanup
tests.query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS CLAUSE_TMP;
